h1: Val Thorens ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Val Thorens sits at 2,300 metres, the highest resort in Les 3 Vallées, on a network of 600 kilometres spanning three valleys and seven resorts. The altitude is the point: it is where the season starts earliest and holds longest in the Tarentaise.
stayOverview: Val Thorens is the high end of the Belleville valley and largely car-free in its centre. Les Menuires below is cheaper on the same pass, and Méribel is the middle of the three valleys.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. The resort's altitude is what you are paying for, so staying lower trades snow reliability for price.
rentalCars: Val Thorens is at the top of the Belleville valley; the drive up is long and the resort centre is largely closed to cars.
